heading: Warning notices on use of lift and escalator
content:
41.
Warning notices on use of lift and escalator
(1)
A notice must be displayed permanently at a conspicuous location of a door or other form of access to the restricted space of a lift or escalator in a building, to caution against—
(a)
the danger of entering the restricted space; and
(b)
the danger of interfering with the operation of the lift or escalator.
(2)
A notice must be displayed permanently at a conspicuous location of every
entrance of a lift to caution against using a lift when there is a
fire.
(3)
A notice referred to in subsection (1) or (2) must be legible and made of durable materials.
